name: Spec-Code-Test Consistency (SCT)
description: Verification kernel for Spec Kit: owns the Evidence Contract (acceptance.yaml), the REQ->AC->TEST->EXECUTION->EVIDENCE traceability chain, and the deterministic PASS/BLOCK/UNPROVEN gate. Language-neutral emitters (JUnit / pytest auto-detected; non-standard projects fall back to static assertions) - the kernel produces the verdict, never the tests.
